aggregation.token_group_score: sum BIOES probabilities within each entity group
aggregation.word_group_score: arithmetic mean across subwords sharing tokenizer word_id
aggregation.word_label: highest group score with O winning exact ties
aggregation.punctuation: discard punctuation-only words and never join across punctuation
aggregation.mention_span: join adjacent PROBLEM words separated only by whitespace or hyphen

limitations: The aggregation was designed after inspecting an exploratory dry-run on this development set.
Results are development evidence and cannot estimate generalization.
No clinical use, diagnosis, HPO linking, or dashboard promotion is permitted.
